Micaiah said, “Behold, you shall see on that day, when you go into an inner room to hide yourself.”
The Lord Yahweh has opened my ear. I was not rebellious. I have not turned back.
I gave my back to those who beat me, and my cheeks to those who plucked off the hair. I didn’t hide my face from shame…
Let him give his cheek to him who strikes him. Let him be filled full of reproach.
Now you shall gather yourself in troops, daughter of troops. He has laid siege against us. They will strike the judge…
Some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to beat him with fists, and to tell him, “Prophesy!” The officers…
They struck his head with a reed, and spat on him, and bowing their knees, did homage to him.
When they had mocked him, they took the purple off him, and put his own garments on him. They led him out to crucify…

The high priest, Ananias, commanded those who stood by him to strike him on the mouth.

saying, “Prophesy to us, you Christ! Who hit you?”

people.name: Micaiah
people.line: A prophet who foretold King Ahab's death.

translations.web: Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah came near, and struck Micaiah on the cheek, and said, “Which way did Yahweh’s Spirit go from me to speak to you?”
translations.bsb: Then Zedekiah son of Chenaanah went up, struck Micaiah in the face, and demanded, “Which way did the Spirit of the LORD go when He departed from me to speak with you?”
translations.kjv: But Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah went near, and smote Micaiah on the cheek, and said, Which way went the Spirit of the LORD from me to speak unto thee?
translations.asv: Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah came near, and smote Micaiah on the cheek, and said, Which way went the Spirit of Jehovah from me to speak unto thee?
